labels.premise: When Aarna's first exhibition is canceled, Mukund comes to help. She needs somewhere to put her grief. He begins looking for a way to save the show. Over one day, two people who love each other discover how far apart those gestures can be.
labels.aarnaDescription: A year of work is waiting in her living room. Today, she does not want to be told how strong she is.
labels.mukundDescription: He leaves work when she calls. Finding a solution is the way he knows to say: you are not alone.
labels.openingDescription: An ordinary morning. An unexpected message.
